zh.title: 美國議員就民用航空器交通資訊接收設備達原則協議 軍機要求未定
zh.summary: 美國議員就民用航空器交通資訊接收設備達原則協議；軍機要求未定，協議仍須國會批准。
body: 美國議員於2026年11月17日達成原則協議，擬要求現已受ADS-B Out規範的民用航空器配備交通資訊接收設備。軍用航空器的設備要求仍未談定。
提案以自動回報監視廣播接收（ADS-B In）為核心，讓航空器接收周圍交通資訊。協議仍須獲得美國國會批准。
這項航空安全立法是由美國航空區域客機與美國陸軍直升機的致命碰撞所促成。兩機在華盛頓雷根國家機場（DCA）附近的波多馬克河上空相撞。2025年1月29日的事故造成美國航空5342號班機上全部64人及陸軍黑鷹直升機上的3名機組員罹難；該班機由PSA Airlines以CRJ700客機執飛。

en.title: US lawmakers agree in principle on aircraft traffic receivers; military requirements unresolved
en.summary: US lawmakers agree on civil aircraft traffic receivers in principle; military requirements remain unresolved and Congress must approve.
body: US lawmakers reached an agreement in principle on November 17, 2026, to require traffic-awareness equipment on civilian aircraft already subject to ADS-B Out rules. Requirements for military aircraft remain unresolved.

The proposal centers on Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast In, or ADS-B In, which allows aircraft to receive information about surrounding traffic. The agreement still requires congressional approval.

The aviation safety legislation was prompted by a fatal collision between an American Airlines regional jet and a US Army helicopter. The aircraft collided over the Potomac River near Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport (DCA). In the January 29, 2025, collision, all 64 people aboard American Airlines Flight 5342, a PSA Airlines-operated CRJ700, and three crew members aboard the Army Black Hawk were killed.

zh.title: 迦納空軍接收Dassault Falcon 6X公務機
zh.summary: 迦納空軍接收Falcon 6X公務機，該機11月16日抵達阿克拉國際機場（ACC）。
body: 迦納空軍接收一架Dassault Falcon 6X長程公務機，預定用於行政運輸。空軍表示，該機於2026年11月16日抵達阿克拉國際機場（ACC）。
飛機抵達時獲得水門禮。國防部長Kenneth Gilbert Adjei、法國駐迦納大使Diarra Dimé Labille及迦納武裝部隊軍方高層出席迎接活動。
迦納國會於2025年12月4日批准兩項採購協議。第一項是與Dassault Aviation的買賣協議，金額為$6,068萬，購買一架Falcon 6X。

en.title: Ghana Air Force takes delivery of Dassault Falcon 6X executive jet
en.summary: Ghana Air Force receives Falcon 6X jet, which arrived at Accra International Airport (ACC) on November 16.
body: The Ghana Air Force has taken delivery of a Dassault Falcon 6X long-range business jet intended for executive transport. The aircraft arrived at Accra International Airport (ACC) on November 16, 2026, the service said.

The jet received a water cannon salute on arrival. Defense Minister Kenneth Gilbert Adjei, French Ambassador to Ghana Diarra Dimé Labille and members of the Ghana Armed Forces’ military high command attended the reception.
Ghana’s Parliament approved two procurement agreements on December 4, 2025. The first was a $60.68 million sale and purchase agreement with Dassault Aviation for one Falcon 6X.

zh.title: 漢莎航空A320商務艙改四座並排、首批6架飛機明年3月上線
zh.summary: 漢莎航空將為6架空中巴士A320-200換裝2-2並排的寬體商務艙躺椅，座椅間距近1公尺，2026年12月16日起陸續上線、2027年3月1日起可預訂法蘭福往返雅典、開羅與尼斯的航班。
body: 德國漢莎航空宣布，將為部分空中巴士A320-200窄體客機換裝四座並排的商務艙躺椅，告別歐洲航空公司常見的「歐洲商務艙」做法。首批6架飛機將在商務艙前兩排改裝2-2配置的寬體躺椅，座椅間距近1公尺、約40英寸，與北美國內頭等艙相當；座椅具備可調椅背、整合式腿靠與腳踏、可收摺餐桌與額外收納空間，改裝期間飛機也將加裝Starlink機上WiFi。

這款產品名為「Premium Business Seat」。漢莎航空表示，目的是測試短中程航線旅客對更高舒適度的需求，以及不同訂位選項的接受度，結果將作為是否擴大提供的依據。旅客自2027年3月1日起可預訂法蘭福出發、往返雅典、開羅與尼斯的航班；改裝完成的飛機預計自2026年12月16日起先在多條航線上陸續投入服務。據Cirium排班資料，2027年3月法蘭福往返開羅每天2班、航程4小時多，尼斯每天2至4班、約90分鐘，雅典每天3至4班、不到3小時。
據ch-aviation資料，漢莎航空共有44架A320-200，此次改裝約占機隊的13.6%。同集團的歐翼之翼也有類似產品「Premium BIZ」，2025年5月公布、11月隨柏林往返杜拜航線上線；該航線今年稍早因中東地緣政治緊張暫停，冬季班表開始後已恢復，12月起也將擴及倫旦、馬拉加與帕爾玛的特定航班。

en.title: Lufthansa fits four-abreast Premium Business Seats on six Airbus A320s
en.summary: Lufthansa will fit six Airbus A320-200s with four-abreast business-class recliners in a 2-2 layout offering almost one metre of seat pitch, rolling out from December 16 and bookable from March 1 on Frankfurt–Athens, Frankfurt–Cairo and Frankfurt–Nice services.
body: Lufthansa has revealed plans to fit select Airbus A320-200 narrowbody twinjets with wider business-class recliners laid out four-abreast in a 2-2 setup, a notable step for a carrier that, like many European flag carriers, has long favoured the flexible 'Eurobusiness' approach of blocked middle seats in six-abreast rows. The change will apply to the first two rows of the business-class cabin on the six aircraft involved, with a seat pitch of almost one metre — almost 40 inches — broadly comparable to North American domestic first class.

Lufthansa has dubbed the product the 'Premium Business Seat'. The recliners offer an adjustable backrest, an integrated leg rest and footrest, a fold-out table, and additional storage space, and the aircraft will also be fitted with Starlink WiFi during refurbishment. The airline says the aim is to examine demand for additional comfort on short and medium-haul routes, as well as the acceptance of different booking options, with the results forming the basis for deciding whether to expand the offering. Passengers can book the seats from March 1 onwards on three routes from Frankfurt: Athens, Cairo and Nice.

According to scheduling data from Cirium, Lufthansa plans to serve Cairo twice a day from Frankfurt in March 2027, with flights taking just over four hours; Nice is 90 minutes away and served two to four times a day, while Athens is served three or four times a day, typically taking just under three hours. The retrofitted jets will initially begin rolling out on various routes from December 16. According to ch-aviation, Lufthansa has 44 A320-200s, so the retrofit concerns 13.6% of the fleet. Eurowings, also in the Lufthansa Group, offers similar four-abreast reclining business-class seats under its Premium BIZ product, which launched on the Berlin–Dubai route in November 2025 and will expand to certain flights to London, Malaga and Palma in December.

zh.title: RTX旗下柯林斯航太在印度動工興建螺旋槳維修廠、2029年初啟用
zh.summary: RTX旗下柯林斯航太已在印度班加羅爾26英畝的印度營運中心動工興建螺旋槳維修廠，預計2029年初啟用，將為ATR42/72區域客機與空中巴士C295軍用運輸機提供螺旋槳維修服務，是印度首家獲外國航太原廠授權的螺旋槳維修廠。
body: RTX旗下柯林斯航太已正式在印度動工興建一座新的螺旋槳維修廠。公司於2026年11月17日宣布，工程已在班加羅爾占地26英畝的柯林斯印度營運中心動土。新廠預計2029年初啟用，將專精於ATR42/72區域客機與空中巴士C295軍用運輸機的先進螺旋槳系統，服務整個亞太地區；柯林斯航太表示，這是印度首家獲外國航太原始設備製造商授權的螺旋槳維修廠。
柯林斯航太先進結構事業總裁阿傑·馬哈詹表示，隨著印度區域航線持續擴張，維持機隊妥善率至關重要；在印度建立螺旋槳維修能力，能把世界級的售後專業直接帶到客戶身邊，縮短維修周轉時間與營運停機時間；卡納塔卡邦政府的支持也促成了這項投資。
柯林斯航太表示，過去5年已投資逾2億美元在印度建立航太服務，涵蓋工程、製造、測試與專業螺旋槳售後維修。印度營運中心於2025年啟用，支援70多種產品與系統的生產；新維修中心將配置最多50名專業技術人員與工程師。印度預計2035年成為全球第三大民航市場，僅次於美國與中國。

en.title: RTX's Collins Aerospace begins work on new propeller MRO facility in India
en.summary: RTX's Collins Aerospace has begun construction of a new propeller maintenance, repair and overhaul facility at its 26-acre India Operations Center in Bengaluru, scheduled to open in early 2029 as the country's first foreign-OEM-authorized propeller MRO shop, serving ATR 42/72 and Airbus C295 operators across Asia Pacific.
body: RTX's Collins Aerospace has officially begun construction work on a new propeller maintenance, repair, and overhaul (MRO) facility in India. On November 17, 2026, the company announced that the first spades were in the ground at the already established 26-acre Collins India Operations Center in Bengaluru. Scheduled to open in early 2029, the facility will specialize in advanced propeller systems for ATR 42/72 regional aircraft and Airbus C295 military transport platforms throughout the Asia Pacific region, and Collins Aerospace says it is the country's first propeller MRO facility authorized by a foreign aerospace original equipment manufacturer.

"As regional connectivity expands across India, maintaining high fleet availability for operators is critical," said Ajay Mahajan, President of Advanced Structures, Collins Aerospace. "By establishing in-country propeller MRO capabilities, we are bringing world-class aftermarket expertise directly to our customers, reducing turnaround times and operational downtime. Support from the government of Karnataka has helped enable this investment."

Collins Aerospace said it has invested more than $200 million over the last five years to help establish aerospace services in India, including engineering, manufacturing, testing and specialized aftermarket propeller maintenance. The Collins India Operations Center opened in 2025 and supports the production of more than 70 products and systems; operations at the new MRO center will include a team of up to 50 specialized technicians and engineers. India is expected to become the third-largest civil aviation market in the world by 2035, behind only the United States and China.

zh.title: 臺灣虎航故宮彩繪機預計11月19日首航 飛往日本福岡
zh.summary: 臺灣虎航與故宮合作彩繪機，預計11月19日首航飛往日本福岡。
body: 臺灣虎航表示，與國立故宮博物院合作的「國寶出遊去」聯名彩繪機，預計11月19日首航飛往日本福岡。雙方9月底攜手，將10件國寶級文物與畫作融入機身設計。
機身視覺以「富春山居圖」的山稜線為底蘊，並呈現「翠玉白菜」、「肉形石」、「毛公鼎」、雕橄欖核舟與「鬥彩雞缸杯」等典藏。古代神獸玉辟邪形狀如飛虎，圖案繪在機身兩側前方。
臺灣虎航董事長黃世惠、總經理邱彰信與故宮副院長黃永泰已到機棚視察完工的彩繪機。首航旅客可獲得限定聯名購物袋。

en.title: Tigerair Taiwan's museum-themed aircraft set for first flight to Fukuoka on Nov. 19
en.summary: Tigerair Taiwan's museum-themed aircraft is scheduled for its first flight to Fukuoka, Japan, on Nov. 19.
body: Tigerair Taiwan says its National Palace Museum-themed aircraft is scheduled to make its first flight in the new livery to Fukuoka, Japan, on Nov. 19. The partners teamed up in late September and based the livery on 10 cultural objects and paintings.

The design draws on the mountain ridges in Dwelling in the Fuchun Mountains and depicts museum pieces including the Jadeite Cabbage, Meat-shaped Stone, Mao Gong Ding, an olive-stone boat carving and the Doucai Chicken Cup. A jade bixie, an ancient mythical creature described as resembling a flying tiger, appears on both sides of the forward fuselage.

The airline's chair and general manager joined the museum's deputy director to inspect the newly painted aircraft in a hangar. Passengers on the first flight can receive a limited-edition co-branded shopping bag.

zh.title: 臺灣虎航宣佈春節營運高雄至東京羽田包機 每日1班
zh.summary: 臺灣虎航將於明年2月1日至15日營運高雄至東京羽田春節包機，每日1班。
body: 臺灣虎航宣佈，因應明年農曆春節旅運需求，將於明年2月1日至15日營運高雄至東京羽田包機航線，每日1班。
這條期間限定的包機航線僅在虎加酒tigertel平臺銷售。臺灣虎航也攜手易飛網推出4種組合套票，結合熱門景點、溫泉及住宿體驗。
目前臺灣虎航自高雄出發的日本航點包括東京成田。航空公司表示，加入羽田包機航線後，高雄及臺南出發航線總數預計將達17條。

en.title: Tigerair Taiwan plans a daily Lunar New Year charter between Kaohsiung and Tokyo Haneda
en.summary: Tigerair Taiwan plans daily charters between Kaohsiung and Tokyo Haneda from February 1 to 15 next year.
body: Tigerair Taiwan said it plans to operate a Lunar New Year charter route between Kaohsiung and Tokyo Haneda from February 1 to 15 next year. The service will run one flight a day.

The limited-period charter will be sold exclusively through the tigertel platform. Tigerair Taiwan is also working with 易飛網 to offer four packages combining popular attractions, hot springs and accommodation.

Tigerair Taiwan’s existing Japanese destinations from Kaohsiung include Tokyo Narita. The airline said the planned Haneda charter would bring the combined number of routes departing Kaohsiung and Tainan to 17.
